jobs.description: 법원경매 kind Gold (root ADR-0287, ADR-0353; scripts/ops/gold-panel-rebuild.sh parcel-court-auction): gold.parcel_court_auction from the court auction item history (silver.court_auction_item), the items in progress as of the build placed on their PNUs, and the sale results (silver.court_auction_sale_result, 매각결과, root ADR-0454) placed the same way. An own-producer kind like 공매, so its own job, not gold_kind_rebuild. Partial: only the PNUs whose items or sale results changed in Silver, whose sale date passed since the last build, or that sit under a code a change of reference.legal_dong_code_change reaches (views.changed_codes; every item PNU is carried to the current code each build, root ADR-0382), are recomputed and merged (root ADR-0312 §2); a new served parcel edition or lineage rebuilds it whole. Started when court_auction_silver (which loads both tables) or legal_dong_code_changes commits, by the asset reconciler (asset_reconcile) when that event was lost, and at 22:05 as the fallback (root ADR-0171), not the public-auction rebuild's 21:35: both take the spark pool and the rebuild lock. A committed rebuild starts by_pnu_court_auction_bake (root ADR-0303).
jobs.memory_measured: no memory peak logged 2026-10-18..11-08 (no cap, so no memory accounting); sized as the script foundation-gold-panel-rebuild.service runs (307M measured, 57 runs); Spark runs in its own capped container; systemd logs the peak of every run under this cap
jobs.disk_measured: not measured: runs no DuckDB stage (none of the publisher's stage commands is in its unit's scripts), so the stage's open check never reads it; 1G is its share of a task's disk on AWS beside its state_paths.

first_run.estimated_from: computed (root ADR-0457, ADR-0566): the same kind of build as gold_public_auction_rebuild (p90 541 s, max 543 s, 15 runs 2026-10-24..11-03), which reads one Silver lane; this one reads the item, sale-result, photo and the 물건상세 document tables, and its first run is whole (the new document inputs are not pinned by the current Gold, so gold_incremental refuses a merge): about three times the public-auction max, 1,800 s, inside the 3,510 s share of its 65-minute limit. It commits once at the end of a build (as_it_goes per build), retries 0.

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.

jobs.description: Reflect each new Gold snapshot of gold.parcel_court_auction (the own-producer court-auction kind, root ADR-0287, ADR-0353) in R2 by-PNU serving (scripts/ops/by-pnu-serving-bake.sh parcel-court-auction), as section packs (root ADR-0147, ADR-0193 §9), exactly as by_pnu_public_auction_bake does for its lane: a change set decides a create-only patch, a reflect-only manifest or a full new generation. Its own job and asset (root ADR-0303, ADR-0333). Until the operator's first cut-over of the lane (its pack-only gate) a run is `nothing to do`. Started when gold_court_auction_rebuild commits a new snapshot, by the asset reconciler (asset_reconcile) when that event was lost, and at 11:05 as the fallback (root ADR-0171), apart from the 10:15, 10:45 and 10:55 bakes so no two clock starts crowd the host at once; each run's containers are its own one-offs (scripts/guard/batch-containers-are-run-scoped.sh). It does not take turns. Two slots and the lane-bake template's MemoryMax=5G (its instance, root ADR-0418 §8b), the ownership bake's bound and for the same reason: two slots so it never runs beside both the panel bake and the public-auction bake (14 + 5 + 5 = 24g would exceed the host budget, root ADR-0138). Its Gold is the parcels with an item in progress, about 40,000 small documents (2026-10-19 Silver: 37,922 items with a PNU).
jobs.disk_measured: not measured: computed bound for a job whose command opens a DuckDB stage over tables of thousands to millions of rows (its stage database and staged files). The stage logs `duckdb stage closed: disk_bytes=<n>` as it closes (root ADR-0622); a pull request replaces this bound with the highest logged value, nothing is kept between runs.

first_run.estimated_from: computed (root ADR-0457): the same lane bake as by_pnu_public_auction_bake (p90 60 s, max 82 s, 42 runs 2026-10-28..11-03); its first run after the 1.4 revision is a new generation of about 44,000 small documents (gold.parcel_court_auction rows, 2026-11-18), about ten times the public-auction max: 900 s, inside the 6,210 s share of its 115-minute limit.

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.

jobs.description: 경매 kind Gold as a table of appended row versions (root ADR-0287, ADR-0353, ADR-0540, ADR-0564 §6; scripts/ops/gold-versions-build.sh parcel-court-auction → publisher build-parcel-court-auction-versions, DuckDB inside the publisher, court_kind_stage): the items in progress as of the build's instant (the site's flag, a sale date on or after that day, not removed), soonest sale first, each with its case's photos and its detail (the 물건상세 and case documents, each code with the site's name), and each parcel's 매각결과 (newest first, at most 50 within 64 KiB, with their total), placed as the 공매 rounds are (auction_placement_stage). Built whole every run (root ADR-0326) and only the PNUs whose digest changed are appended. While it shadows gold.parcel_court_auction, nobody reads it: the takeover_equal check judges 시도 41 against the replaced table.
jobs.memory_measured: its own: run 20261119T152616Z of foundation-gold-versions@parcel-nearby (2026-11-19 15:26-15:51Z, every served parcel, 39,861,511 rows committed in 1500 s), systemd's memory peak 7.2G, swap peak 13.5M; the publisher's own peak in its run log 7,733,563,392 bytes
jobs.memory_headroom_why: The peak follows the cap, not the work: the publisher gives DuckDB three fifths of what the unit has left under MemoryHigh (duckdb_parquet_stage MEMORY_SHARE) and DuckDB fills it and the page cache, so a larger memory_max would only raise the peak. The run fit: no timeout, 13.5M swap, under MemoryMax
jobs.disk_measured: not measured: the build holds one 시도's stage database and staged files at a time and checkpoints after each part (root ADR-0599: about 43 GB over 15 시도 before the checkpoint, ~2.9 GB a 시도); 8G is that twice over with the change set. The stage logs `duckdb stage closed: disk_bytes=<n>` as it closes (root ADR-0622); a pull request replaces this bound with the highest logged value, nothing is kept between runs.

first_run.estimated_from: computed, not measured: every run reads the served parcel edition's PNUs (about 40 million, as gold_public_auction_versions_build, estimated 900 s), the court auction Silver tables (tens of thousands of items and results, the document tables per case) and the parcel lineage whole once, places and renders the items in progress and the results, and folds each 시도; about 900 s, inside the 60-minute limit.

expected_outcome.basis: it rebuilds once a day from the nightly court collection; two daily turns, as gold_court_auction_rebuild.

assets.title: 필지 법원경매 by-PNU 표
assets.description: PNU마다 빌드 시각에 진행 중인 법원경매 물건을 매각기일이 이른 순서로, 그 필지의 매각결과를 매각기일이 늦은 순서로 최대 50건 담는 데이터 종류 표(루트 ADR-0287, ADR-0353, ADR-0454). 계약의 종류 한 줄(parcel-court-auction)이 자기 생산자를 이름 짓고, 필지 패널이 아니라 법원경매 Silver 에서 만든다. 공매(parcel-public-auction)의 자리 정하기를 함께 쓰고, 바뀐 물건이 닿는 PNU 만 다시 만든다. 목록 검색에는 사진이 없어 사진 색인이 없다. 이 행을 보여 주는 화면은 출처(대한민국법원 법원경매정보)를 표시해야 한다(저작권법 제24조의2, 루트 ADR-0281 §6).

assets.title: 필지 법원경매 by-PNU 묶음 파일
assets.description: gold.parcel_court_auction 의 PNU 문서를 법정동 묶음으로만 굽는다. 필지 호스트의 Worker 가 /parcels/court-auction/by-pnu/ 경로로 서빙한다(루트 ADR-0193, ADR-0287, ADR-0353). 자기 굽기 작업(by_pnu_court_auction_bake)이 돈다(루트 ADR-0303). 첫 발행은 운영자의 묶음 전용 관문을 거친다.

assets.title: 필지 경매 by-PNU 표(판을 쌓는 표)
assets.description: 루트 ADR-0353 의 경매 by-PNU 표를 판을 쌓는 표로(루트 ADR-0564 §1·§2): gold.parcel_court_auction 의 칸에 version_seq·row_state 를 더해 바뀐 PNU 의 행만 덧붙인다. 현재 행은 PNU 마다 version_seq 가 가장 큰 행이고 row_state 가 removed 면 그 PNU 는 없다. 빌드 시각에 진행 중인 물건이 실리므로, 커밋마다 그 시각을 적는다(foundation.as-of). 전환할 때까지 옛 표의 그림자다(옛 표 빌드 태그의 입력 핀과 그 빌드의 시각으로 짓는다).

dependencies.description: 자기 생산자를 가진 종류(루트 ADR-0287, ADR-0353): 법원경매 물건 이력에서 PNU 를 정하고 진행 중인 물건만 PNU 문서로 묶는다. 바뀐 물건과 매각기일이 지난 물건이 닿는 PNU 만 다시 만들어 합친다(루트 ADR-0312 §2).
매각결과의 현재 행을 물건과 같은 자리 정하기로 PNU 에 놓고, 짓기마다 PNU 를 현재 법정동 코드로 옮긴다. 결과 행이 바뀐 물건이 닿는 PNU(바뀌기 전과 뒤)만 다시 만든다(루트 ADR-0454).
물건의 PNU 를 짓기마다 정본 해석기의 쌍으로 현재 법정동 코드에 옮긴다. 이 표가 바뀌면 바뀐 코드(views.changed_codes) 아래 물건이 닿는 PNU 만 다시 만든다(루트 ADR-0382, ADR-0329 §3).
법원경매 Gold 의 PNU 문서를 법정동 묶음으로 굽는다. 자기 굽기 작업이 Gold 커밋마다 바뀐 PNU 만 덧씌운다(루트 ADR-0303).
사건의 사진을 그 사건의 모든 물건 회차에 rounds[].photos 로 싣는다. 사진이 바뀐 사건의 PNU 만 다시 만든다(루트 ADR-0384).
행마다 그 필지의 안정 place_id 를 싣는다(루트 ADR-0483, ADR-0288 §5): 다리의 필지 단위 열린 기간(없으면 마지막 기간)의 id. 짓는 PNU 의 다리 행만 읽는다.
발행이 덧붙인 변경 이력 행의 코드(옛·새)만 다시 계산한다(루트 ADR-0483): 이력은 append-only 라 고정한 스냅숏 뒤에 붙은 행만 읽는다.
진행 물건 회차의 detail(사건 기본·매각물건명세서 요약·기일내역·목록내역·제시외건물·감정요항표)로 싣는다. 레지스트리 개정 1.4, 바뀐 물건·사건의 PNU 만 다시 짓는다(루트 ADR-0540 §5).

상세의 가장 새 현황조사 회차.
그 회차의 목록(최신 판).

상세의 가장 새 감정평가 회차.

상세의 문건(최신 판, 이름 없이).
상세의 송달(최신 판, 이름 없이).
상세의 정정·취소변경 공고(최신 판).
상세의 배당요구종기공고.
서빙 필지판의 PNU: 물건이 그 PNU 에 있으면 그 PNU 에 싣는다(루트 ADR-0292).
폐쇄된 PNU 의 물건을 현재 후속 필지와 병합된 필지로 옮긴다(lineage_carry_stage, 루트 ADR-0113 §6); 길이 없으면 세되 싣지 않는다.
위치 PNU 의 코드를 현재 코드로, 서빙판이 옛 코드를 쥔 필지는 옛 형태로 찾는다(루트 ADR-0329 §3, ADR-0482 §1).
행마다 그 필지의 place_id(루트 ADR-0483).
그림자인 동안 옛 표의 foundation-gold-build 태그 커밋이 적은 입력 핀과 그 빌드의 시각(행들의 가장 늦은 published_at_utc)으로 짓는다(루트 ADR-0564 §6).
레인의 넘겨받기 PR 이 종류 줄의 gold_table 을 이 표로 바꾸면(판정 뒤, 루트 ADR-0564 §6) 레인의 굽기가 이 표의 현재 행을 읽는다. 그때까지 아무도 읽지 않는 그림자다.
